_prompt_rules: Every constraint below is in the prompt text on purpose. They are not notes and not
reminders -- they run on every generation and are visible in the job file.
1. FEET: 'both feet complete and fully visible standing flat on the ground, legs and
boots drawn in full, nothing cut off at the bottom edge.' A run shipped with the
legs sliced off by the frame and the QA passed it, because the check only asked
whether any pixel touched the bottom row.
2. TOP: 'empty space above the helmet crest, the crest complete and not touching the
top edge.' A run shipped with the crest clipped and the QA scored it as ideal,
because the check rewarded maximum height fill.
3. BUILD: 'head about one quarter of the total height.' Measured from the reference
sprites (1:4.1); an earlier run came back slim and tall and read as another game.
4. RENDER: 'bold flat blocks of colour, few colours, hard dark outline, no gradients.'
The reference is 14 colours; a 31 colour result passed a self-invented 12-40 band
and still read thin and washed out beside it.
_review_rule: Look at the image at 10x beside the reference before reporting anything. The metrics are a floor, never the verdict. Do not report PASS from a script.
